title: Reasonable Vanilla Tweaks
description: A Minecraft datapack that makes Vanilla tweaks that are must be in Minecraft by default
body:
## Features
- Added [Crafting Recipes](https://github.com/pitomec/Reasonable-Vanilla-Tweaks/wiki/Crafting-Recipes) for some obtainable items
- Added crafting recipe for an invisible item frame and it's glow variant
- Added earth, wind, fire, water - [Painting Variants](https://github.com/pitomec/Reasonable-Vanilla-Tweaks/wiki/Painting-Variants) to painting pool
- Creeper, zombie, piglin and skeleton now drop their heads respectively with the same chance as the Wither Skeleton
## Known Issues
When Invisible Item Frame breaks, it drops its default variant
## Credits
- [Better Craftables](https://github.com/Classics-Craftworks/Better-Craftables) - Some recipes
- [Taya](https://github.com/Classics-Craftworks/Better-Craftables) - Invisible Item Frame recipe
